text:
[Council File 26-1486; CD 4]
Motion (Raman - Nazarian) relative to expanding the design scope for Segment 8 of the LARiverWay Valley Completion Project to incorporate a holistic look at Whitsett Avenue, and a contribution from the Harvard-Westlake School for a new Whitsett Avenue crossing.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Expands the design work for Segment 8 of the LARiverWay Valley Completion Project to study Whitsett Avenue and add a new crossing, with a contribution from Harvard-Westlake School.

flag.reason: LA River greenway segment affecting public open space and crossings.
